Say in Chinese what picture you want; the more specific the better (people, clothes, place, light, composition).
The assistant writes the English prompt, draws, checks each of your requests against the images, fixes what is wrong and draws again, then hands you the best ones.
You can also cut in while it works; the next round follows what you said.
It can do more too: upscale, remove backgrounds, fix faces and hands, edit, extend, character turnarounds, videos, comics, gallery searches, switching models… It asks you first before spending money, deleting anything or changing settings.
